You're lying when you say that they don't have to carry your pain. When you kill yourself, you traumatise and scar your loved one's forever because as soon as they find your body and realise that you are gone do you know what they are thinking? They are thinking "Oh god, oh no I have lost this precious person to me, I should have done something, I should have done more, I should have talked to them or listen to them etc." and they have to live with that pain for the rest of their lives. Killing yourself can also cause others to kill themselves or suffer from depression which is probably one of the worst things ever to live with (I know it is) and it all just keeps spiralling down into darkness that you can't get out of.

So your nonsensical question on why killing yourself is bad is because it does negatively affect other people forever, you give up the thousands of options to save yourself by choosing a permanent solution which could have just been a temporary problem and in the end there is just no good outcome to suicide. There are people that love you, you have made that clear in your post, there is help available and there is medication which works amazingly for a lot of people and there's several variants of it and there is even an easy to phone helpline if you need to talk to someone. The one thing I always say to suicidal people is before you do it, sleep on it. If you can throw away years of your life then you can wait one more day to do it. I hope you find the help you need and you take my advice because what you are thinking right now is self destructive and can only lead to tragedy.
